title: Maan Ba Qurbaan E Hussain
body:
Maan Ba Qurbaan E Hussain
Jaan Ba Qurbaan E Hussain
Na Zan Eeyi Taqme Zana Chob Ba Dandaan E Hussain
Chaub E Na'ae Daur Kan Az Laal E Darqsahaan E Hussain
1. Az Khuda Shram Kan Aayi Kafir E Bi Sharm O Haaya Taaba Ke Jor O Jafa
Makan Eein Bi Aadabi Peash E Aseeran E Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aayi Yazeed Eein Lab O Dandaan Ke Ba Khoon Gashta Khisaab
Ba Shudi Dur E Khushaab
Roz O Shab Bosa Gahe Jad E Pareshaan E Hussain
